work.title: Rifle Stencil, Snowman
work.description: Layered street art on a dark wall features a black-and-white stenciled figure holding an automatic rifle below spray-painted text reading 'BEN NAZ,' accompanied by a small cartoon character with glasses and a circular skull-and-laurel emblem at left. At right, a yellow and white illustrated building paste-up adjoins orange-painted graffiti tags.
work.composition: central rifle stencil with text and snowman icon
